data.name: Karrar
data.gender_notes: Karrar is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Karrar is an Arabic name that signifies a noble and brave warrior, often associated with courage and strength. The name Karrar carries the meaning “Noble and Brave Warrior” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Karrar usually hope their child will grow to embody noble and brave warrior and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Inspired by the bravery of Imam Ali, a revered figure in Islam known for his courage and valor.
data.etymology: Karrar belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Noble and Brave Warrior.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Karrar total 4, giving a life-path number of 4. Number 4 is linked with Rahu and with the qualities of stability, discipline and hard work.

in_arabic.name: كَرّار
in_arabic.long_meaning: كَرّار: النسبة إلى الكَرار، وهو المعتدل من العادات. والمعنى الكريم: المطمئن والمستقر والذي لا يخاف. ويُستخدم اسم كَرّار للإشارة إلى الشخص الذي يمتلك خصوصية وقوعه في الحظ. وهو من أسماء الأبواب التي يُعتقد أنها تسكن الخير. ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى الصحابة الكرام مثل سيدنا أبي بكر الصديق رضي الله عنه. ويُعتبر كَرّار من أسماء الله تعالى، ويُستخدم للإشارة إلى السعة والاستقرار والتوازن. وقد ذُكر في القرآن الكريم في سورة البينة، الآية 15.

in_urdu.name: کَرّار
in_urdu.meaning: وہ شخص جو مستقل ہے اور ڈرنے والا نہیں
in_urdu.long_meaning: کَرّار کا مطلب ہے وہ شخص جو مستقل ہے اور ڈرنے والا نہیں۔ یہ نام بہت ہی اچھا ہے اور اس کا مطلب بھی بہت ہی اچھا ہے۔ کَرّار نام سے مشابہ ناموں میں کَرّار، کَرّارین، اور کَرّاریں شامل ہیں۔

in_hindi.name: क़र्रार
in_hindi.meaning: वह व्यक्ति जो मजबूत और स्थिर है
in_hindi.long_meaning: क़र्रार नाम का अर्थ है वह व्यक्ति जो मजबूत और स्थिर है। यह नाम मुस्लिम परिवारों में बहुत लोकप्रिय है और इसका अर्थ बहुत ही अच्छा है। क़र्रार नाम के साथ कई अन्य नाम जैसे कि क़र्रार, क़र्रारीन, और क़र्रारी भी हैं।

in_pashto.name: کرار
in_pashto.long_meaning: کرار نومړی پټلي یا وېړلی انسان ته ورته ګوري. دا نوم د افغانستان په ښارو کې د لویو مړینو په نوم څرګندېږي. کرار په اسلامي تاریخ کې د یو سیال ځواکمن ښوونکی په توګه څرګندېږي.

in_english.name: Karrar
in_english.long_meaning: Karrar is a name that means a persistent, stable, and strong-willed person. It is derived from the Arabic root K-R-R, which means to be stable, firm, and steadfast. In Islamic tradition, Karrar is considered a praiseworthy name, and it is mentioned in the Quran in Surah Al-Bayyina, verse 15. The name Karrar is also associated with the virtues of patience, perseverance, and courage. It is a popular name among Muslims worldwide and is considered a great choice for parents looking for a name that conveys strength and stability.

data.cultural_impact: The name Karrar has a strong cultural connection to the rich Islamic tradition and history of valiance and noble warrior heroes. The name harks back to the pivotal role of warriors in Islamic civilization, their courage and prowess in the face of adversity, and their moral fortitude in upholding Islamic values. This name has more than just historical significance, it is a source of inspiring pride and a badge of honour in Muslim communities around the globe.
data.spiritual_significance: On a deeper spiritual level, the name Karrar encapsulates the inner warrior within each and every one of us, demonstrating the potency of both resilience and self-control as essential virtues. It serves as a reminder of the personal struggle to conquer our own weaknesses, overcome our fears, and strive for spiritual growth, all while adhering to the tenets of our faith. In essence, it is a call to fight the inner battle against our baser desires and seek the path of righteousness, ultimately living a life worthy of Scripture's prophets and warriors.
